<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.0924 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈1 % M+1) and the odd nominal mass of the ion indicate the presence of a single nitrogen atom. The formula that matches this exact mass within <1 mDa is C₇H₁₂NO (exact mass 126.0919 Da). Therefore the molecular formula is C7H12NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
